name: pawgo-walking-dog
description: Pawgo walking-dog loader animation. Authored in Remotion, exported to GIF for Flutter consumption.

scripts.export-gif: remotion render WalkingDog out/walking-dog.gif --codec=gif --scale=0.5 && gifsicle -O3 --colors 32 --lossy=30 out/walking-dog.gif -o ../../lib/assets/animations/walking_dog.gif
